findings.summary: Error banner uses hardcoded red-200/red-50/red-800 Tailwind colors instead of the --danger/--danger-soft design tokens, so it will not adapt to dark theme.
findings.fix: Replace with token-driven classes, e.g. className="mb-5 rounded-xl border border-[var(--danger)] bg-[var(--danger-soft)] p-4 text-sm text-[var(--danger)]" (matching the app's .status-danger pattern).

findings.summary: Success banner hardcodes emerald-200/emerald-50/emerald-800 instead of --success/--success-soft tokens, breaking dark-theme and brand consistency.
findings.fix: Use border-[var(--success)] bg-[var(--success-soft)] text-[var(--success)] instead of the emerald-* utilities.

findings.summary: Step indicator's completed/current states use hardcoded emerald-300/emerald-50/emerald-800 rather than success tokens, inconsistent with the tokenized theme.
findings.fix: Swap emerald-* for --success tokens (e.g. border-[var(--success)] bg-[var(--success-soft)] text-[var(--success)]) for the completed step while keeping the brand classes for the active step.

findings.summary: Primary/next/submit buttons are bespoke inline styles (bg-brand px-5 py-3 ...) instead of reusing the shared .btn-primary class, and the prev/back buttons reimplement .btn-secondary.
findings.fix: Apply className="btn-primary" to next/submit buttons and className="btn-secondary" to the previous and header back buttons, removing the duplicated inline padding/color utilities.

findings.summary: Remove-photo button and photo-error text hardcode red-200/red-700 rather than the --danger token.
findings.fix:
Use border-[var(--danger)] text-[var(--danger)] (and text-[var(--danger)] for the error

at line 123) instead of red-* utilities.

findings.summary: The role <select> (المنصب) and the structure SelectField/JobTitleField selects rely only on a visible label sibling with no aria-label, and icon-only nature of some controls is fine but selects lack explicit accessible naming for screen readers in RTL.
findings.fix: Add aria-label matching each field label to the select/input elements (e.g. aria-label="المنصب" on line 130 select and pass label through as aria-label in SelectField/JobTitleField), consistent with FilterBar's aria-labeled selects.

findings.summary: The structure lookups error uses hardcoded red-50/red-700 while the rest of the app uses tokenized banners, and there is no loading skeleton shown while lookups.isLoading.
findings.fix: Use --danger tokens for the error banner and add a lightweight loading state (e.g. disabled selects or a small spinner) when lookups.isLoading, matching LoadingScreen/app patterns.

findings.summary: Placeholder icon and helper text use the ad-hoc 'muted' class and text-[var(--muted)]; the documented token is --text-muted, so --muted may be an undefined/legacy var.
findings.fix: Confirm the token name and use text-[var(--text-muted)] for the ImagePlus placeholder and helper copy to align with the documented design tokens.
